definitions.explanation: A place where films are shown to an audience, or the art and industry of filmmaking.

examples.japanese: シネマコンプレックス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観|み}た→観る：22793_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a movie at the cinema complex.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧シネマ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new cinema opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦フランス→フランス：19418_furansu⟧シネマ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特集|とくしゅう}→特集：13468_tokushuu⟧⟦{上映|じょうえい}→上映：08380_jouei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A French cinema special screening series is being held.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シネマコンプレックス (シネコン): cinema complex, multiplex
- ⟦{名画|めいが}→名画：17385_meiga⟧シネマ: classic film cinema
- ミニシアター: small independent cinema (art-house theater)

USAGE:
シネマ is used more as a proper name element in theater names and compounds (シネマコンプレックス, シネコン) than in everyday conversation. When talking about going to the movies, ⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧ is the standard word. シネマ carries a slightly more sophisticated or artistic nuance.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧: movie theater (standard everyday term)
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: movie, film
- ⟦シアター→シアター：15079_shiataa⟧: theater (also used in cinema complex names)
